page.layout: One printed page: a running head with page number at top; below it a header line; then two stacked calendar tables, each of 15 numbered rows, with columns for Ind., An.Iul., Lit.dom., Nabon., Feriæ, Maij dates, and two right-hand numerical columns. A rule separates the two tables. Below the second table, a rule and a small number at the lower right. No margin notes.

page.notes: The superscript marks after 76, 89 and 93 are small italic letters (a, b, c), read as reference marks; the mark after 76 is less certain. The small figure before 433 at the lower right is read as "1" and may be a signature or catchword. The right running head is partly worn at its final letter, read as "Diocle" with the rest illegible. Long s in the header is written as plain s.
